observations: Black surface with a grid of photovoltaic cells.
Watermark 'SUNCITY SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across the center.
The panel is leaning against a wall in a domestic or workshop setting.

claims.evidence: The panel is large enough to be 485W, but the brand and wattage are not clearly legible in photo 0.
No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The panel may be a lower wattage model or a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have cell damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).

risks.risk: The panel may be used or have a damaged frame.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the frame and the back of the panel.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the back of the panel showing the serial number and specifications.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's electrical output.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
